root_cause.text: The `dpu_encoder_phys_wb_setup_ctl` function in the MSM DRM driver lacks a NULL pointer check on the pingpong interface (`phys_enc->hw_pp`) before dereferencing it to access the `merge_3d` block.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces the direct dereference of `phys_enc->hw_pp->merge_3d` with a safe check using the local variable `hw_pp` (which represents `phys_enc->hw_pp`): `if (hw_pp && hw_pp->merge_3d && hw_pp->merge_3d->ops.setup_3d_mode)`.
